title: Leaving the gym keeps the mobile number a member typed at check-in
what: When a member types a mobile number at check-in, it waits for the desk to confirm. If the member then leaves the gym in the app, the number is cleared from their app record but stays in the waiting request. The owner and front desk still see that request with the number, and approved or declined requests keep the number with no clean-up.
expected: Leaving the gym removes or blanks every mobile number the member gave, waiting requests included, as the delete-account page promises.
who: members who typed a number and then left
how_often: every time such a member leaves
fix_line: Clear the member's number requests when they leave
